title: fix(bundlesize): consolidate usage of "classnames" helper
body:
**Summary**

We have this helper in `@algolia/ui-components-shared` as well as in `classnames`. I chose to consolidate on our own helper

**Result**

* simpler classes (always with conditional rather than object form)
* one less dependency
* slightly smaller bundlesize (difference: 200 bytes only 😢)

FX-1857
